Class ConfigurationFileReader

java.lang.Object
org.uma.evolver.util.ConfigurationFileReader
public class ConfigurationFileReader extends Object
Utility class for reading and accessing configurations from a text file containing a configuration of a base-level metaheuristic per line. Each line in the file represents a single configuration.
Author:
Antonio J. Nebro
